state.goal: Prepare a prioritized implementation plan for a customer support portal, including account recovery, accessibility, and a release check.

evidence.text: Prepare a prioritized implementation plan for a customer support portal, including account recovery, accessibility, and a release check.
The team has approved a first release for existing customers. Implementation work has not started.

Define account recovery acceptance criteria
Define accessibility verification
Customers should be able to sign in, recover an account, open a support request, and read the request status. The first release must work with keyboard navigation and screen readers.
